Cc: Priya Desai <priya@parkway.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo to review recent usage spike and next steps

Hi Olga —

We signed up a couple of weeks ago and have been running some inference jobs against the self-serve API. We just crossed the threshold your team mentioned in the docs and I wanted to see if someone from Redwood could walk us through best practices for configuring batching and KV caching — trying to get cost predictable before we expand usage.

Would a 30-minute call this week work? We have engineers in PST and our data lead Priya is on ET. Ideally late-morning PST or early afternoon ET.

Also attaching a brief export of our token usage (sanitized). Hope it helps you understand our pattern.

Thanks,
Samir
Director of ML Engineering
Parkway Analytics

Attachment: parkway-usage-snapshot-20261101.csv (csv, 42 KB)

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.example>
To: Samir Shah <samir@parkway.ai>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.example
Date: 2026-11-01T11:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo to review recent usage spike and next steps

Samir — great to hear from you and congrats on the early ramp. I reviewed the snapshot and there are a couple of quick wins we can walk through (batching window, prefix cache for your 1.5k token prompts, and a quantization suggestion for the encoder-heavy paths).

Can we do a short 30-minute session? My available slots this week (PT):
- Tue 11/02 10:30–11:00
- Tue 11/02 15:00–15:30
- Wed 11/03 09:00–09:30

If none work, tell me a couple windows that suit the team and I’ll send a calendar invite. I’ll bring Ben from Solutions (CC’d) to cover deployment/ops suggestions and any billing/commit questions.

Quick ask: can you share which model variant you’ve been calling (model id or name) and whether you’re on hosted or a Dedicated eval? That will help us tailor the runbook.

Best,
Olga Petrov
SDR, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.example
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment referenced: parkway-usage-snapshot-20261101.csv

Note: Ben can take notes and follow up with a short ops checklist after the call.
